title: packets/timing vector generator treats --check as a destructive regeneration
description: test/vectors/generate_packets_timing.py ignores argv and always rewrites both canonical JSON outputs. Unlike sibling generators, invoking it with --check still mutates packets-formats.json and packets-timing.json and reports Wrote, so CI/review commands intended only to detect drift can bless or clobber authoritative vectors. Parse arguments explicitly, implement a non-writing byte/JSON comparison for --check, reject unknown arguments, and regress output mtimes/content on check and usage errors.
